verdict.rationale: Plausible documents a read-only Stats API whose /api/v2/query endpoint takes simple and complex queries in a POST body and returns metrics as JSON, using team-scoped API keys. A separate 'Export stats' feature lets users download data. Nothing shows the API or export returning raw, event-level rows; the evidence points to aggregated metrics only, which covers the query half of the story but not the raw-event-pull half. Missing for 10: documented raw event-level export via API, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes all 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of query depth.
